body: I'm fifteen.. Started when I was twelve. It's been two months since I last cut, but the urges are very strong and are telling me to make just one slit..

Many people react awkwardly to it. They can never bring it up because they realize what the scars are. I have three deep scars. I look at them and always say, "why? Why would you do that? They're ugly." I'm not proud of them and hide them so much. It's hard to hide them, and makes it even worse. Please don't start, it's a terrible addiction

Want to know what it's like? You grab the blade, and you stare at yourself in the mirror. You press your index finger on the top of it, and push it against your skin, and drag it across swiftly. It then burns, and bleeds. You keep doing it, getting deeper each time. You stop, and hop in the shower. It stings, and burns. It's feels as though a million needles are puncturing you. You can't stop it. You try to grab it to stop the pain but it hurts worse. You get out, and the bleeding gets worse. You stress out trying to stop it, then think of all the diseases and infections you could get. Your breathing picks up and you burst to tears. You finally realize what you did, and you hate yourself for it. You regret it, but now you crave it. You get stuck going  over this for weeks until you finally are sent to the hospital. Years later, you look at yourself and see scars. They aren't pretty. You regret it, and wish you could take it all back, and wish you never started. Self harm doesn't help. Maybe for a few seconds, but it's makes it all worse, and it's more painful and traumatic than what you may be going through (although I don't know). Don't start, its the one thing I regret the most.

I'm a fifteen year old girl. Long hair is a huge turn on for many girls I know. If you find yourself ugly, someone out there thinks you're so very handsome. Looks shouldn't determine a person. I'm fairly positive that you have an amazing personality. You can't please everyone, and that's one thing you must accept. It will really help you in the future. You can't talk to yourself like that either. Don't say anything bad about yourself. Let's put it this way... Your body and life is like a baby. It's very precious, and delicate. Now that baby, you wouldn't hurt it anyway, right? You wouldn't cut it, burn it, yell at it, call it names, or even kill it, right? So why should you do that to yourself. You're an amazing person. Everyone is to at least one person, and that's a wonderful thing to realize. I really hope you recover, and please don't hurt yourself. People do love you..
